fullContentHtml:
NABARD Assistant Manager Grade-A Score Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : National Bank For Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) has released the Score Card for the NABARD Assistant Manager Grade-A Posts on the official website of the NABARD. This recruitment was released for 91 posts. Applications for the NABARD Assistant Manager Grade-A Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 08 November 2025, to 30 November 2025. The Phase-2 examination was conducted on 25 January 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their NABARD Assistant Manager Grade-A Score Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 08 November 2025
  • Last Date : 30 November 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 30 November 2025
  • Phase I Exam Date : 20 December 2025
  • Phase I Admit Card : 14 December 2025
  • Phase I Result : 09 January 2026
  • Phase-II Exam Date : 25 January 2026
  • Phase-II Admit Card : 16 January 2026
  • Mains Result : 27 February 2026
  • Mains Result : 06 May 2026
  • Score Card : 31 July 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 850/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 150/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
